---
title: "Selectors and roles"
---


Recipe steps operate on columns of data, which are specified using Polars selectors.
While Polars selectors can specify pieces like all numeric columns (`cs.numeric()`),
they can't target modelling pieces like all "feature" columns.
shoez enables this by adding Roles, modelling specific labels for columns and selectors to target them.

## Roles: features and targets

  - "target"
